mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_settings ( user_id, personality_preset, openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, neuroticism, sensitivity, decay_rate, regression_rate, tts_enabled, tts_volume, tts_speed, proactive_enabled, proactive_interval_min, theme_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{settings.personalityPreset}, #{settings.openness}, #{settings.conscientiousness}, #{settings.extraversion}, #{settings.agreeableness}, #{settings.neuroticism}, #{settings.sensitivity}, #{settings.decayRate}, #{settings.regressionRate}, #{settings.ttsEnabled}, #{settings.ttsVolume}, #{settings.ttsSpeed}, #{settings.proactiveEnabled}, #{settings.proactiveIntervalMin}, #{settings.themeId} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE personality_preset = new.personality_preset, openness = new.openness, conscientiousness = new.conscientiousness, extraversion = new.extraversion, agreeableness = new.agreeableness, neuroticism = new.neuroticism, sensitivity = new.sensitivity, decay_rate = new.decay_rate, regression_rate = new.regression_rate, tts_enabled = new.tts_enabled, tts_volume = new.tts_volume, tts_speed = new.tts_speed, proactive_enabled = new.proactive_enabled, proactive_interval_min = new.proactive_interval_min, theme_id = new.theme_id
